## FunctionsPage

- **Iframe:** top-level page
- **Properties:**

  - `functionNameTrigger` — selector: `[data-test="add-function-name-input-trigger"]`

  - `functionEditor` — selector: `[data-test="logs-vrl-function-editor"]`
  - `saveButton` — selector: `[data-test="add-function-save-btn"]`
  - `cancelButton` — selector: `[data-test="add-function-cancel-btn"]`
  - `searchInputField` — selector: `[data-test="functions-list-search-input-field"]`
- **Methods:**
  - `navigate(org)` — goes to functions page; ⏱ timing-aware: waitForTimeout(2000)
  - `clickAddFunctionButton(org)` — clicks add button with auto-recovery; ⏱ timing-aware: waitForTimeout(500)+waitForTimeout(1000)
  - `fillFunctionName(name)` — clicks name trigger then fills input

  - `clickSaveButton()` — clicks save; ⏱ timing-aware: waitForTimeout(2000)

  - `deleteFunctionByName(functionName, org)` — full delete workflow
